# @rxova/react-otp-input

> A headless, accessible one-time-code input for React. One real `<input>` sits
> under the slots, so paste, SMS autofill, IME, undo, native form submission and
> screen-reader semantics all come from the platform rather than from JavaScript.
> Zero runtime dependencies. No stylesheet to import.

## Install

    npm install @rxova/react-otp-input

`react >= 18` is the only peer dependency.

## Minimal working example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { OtpInput } from '@rxova/react-otp-input'

export function Verify() {
  const [code, setCode] = useState('')

  return (
    <OtpInput
      length={6}
      value={code}
      onChange={setCode}
      onComplete={(final) => verify(final)}
      label="One-time code"
    />
  )
}
```

`onChange` receives the sanitized **string**, not an event.

## Props

`<OtpInput>` — the full surface is `OtpInputProps` in the published types.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | `number` | `6` | Number of slots. Positive integer. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled. Sanitized to allowed chars and clamped to `length`; never throws. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | Uncontrolled initial value. Ignored when `value` is set. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Emits the sanitized string, not an event. |
| `onComplete` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Fires once the value reaches `length`. |
| `mode` | `'numeric' \| 'alphanumeric' \| 'alpha'` | `'numeric'` | Drives `inputMode`, `pattern`, `autoCapitalize`. |
| `pattern` | `RegExp \| string` | — | Per-character allow test. Beats `mode`. |
| `transform` | `(value: string) => string` | — | Normalizes each committed value, after `pattern`. |
| `pasteTransform` | `(pasted: string) => string` | strips whitespace and `- . _` | Cleans pasted text before distributing. |
| `autoComplete` | `string` | `'one-time-code'` | The attribute that unlocks iOS/Android SMS suggestions. |
| `webOTP` | `boolean` | `false` | Opt into the WebOTP API (Android Chrome). Layered on top of `autoComplete`, never instead of it. |
| `slotInteraction` | `'spatial' \| 'crush'` | `'spatial'` | `'spatial'` lets a tap land on any slot; auto-degrades to `'crush'` on iOS. |
| `mask` | `boolean \| string` | — | Render a mask char instead of the value. `true` → `•`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | Per-slot placeholder shown while empty. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `blurOnComplete` | `boolean` | `false` | Dismisses the mobile keyboard once complete. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Posts natively in a `<form>`; the name RHF/Formik bind to. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`. |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | — | Fires when focus leaves the whole control, never between slots. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name for the field. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | id(s) of external error/help text. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Base id; slots derive `${id}-slot-0`, … |
| `inputRef` | `Ref<HTMLInputElement>` | — | Ref to the underlying `<input>`. |
| `dir` | `'ltr' \| 'rtl'` | inherited | |
| `nonce` | `string` | — | CSP nonce for any injected style. |
| `className` | `string` | — | |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | — | |
| `render` | `(ctx: OtpRenderContext) => ReactNode` | — | Escape hatch. Ignored when children are provided. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Compose `OtpGroup` / `OtpSlot` / `OtpSeparator` yourself. |

Also exported: `OtpGroup`, `OtpSlot`, `OtpSeparator`, and the hooks `useOtpInput`
and `useWebOTP` for building your own markup.

## Styling

There is no stylesheet. Set CSS custom properties on any ancestor:

`--rx-otp-slot-size`, `--rx-otp-gap`, `--rx-otp-font`, `--rx-otp-font-size`, `--rx-otp-color`,
`--rx-otp-bg`, `--rx-otp-border`, `--rx-otp-radius`, `--rx-otp-active-ring`,
`--rx-otp-caret-color`, `--rx-otp-caret-width`, `--rx-otp-placeholder-color`,
`--rx-otp-separator-color`, `--rx-otp-transition`.

`--rx-otp-font` sets the face of the slots and separators; unset, they use the page's font.

Or target the `data-*` attributes, which are public API covered by semver:
`data-rx-otp-root`, `data-rx-otp-input`, `data-rx-otp-group`, `data-rx-otp-slot`,
`data-rx-otp-separator`, `data-rx-otp-caret`, plus the state hooks `data-state`,
`data-filled`, `data-active`, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly`, `data-invalid`.

## Three mistakes to avoid

1. **Rendering one `<input>` per slot.** There is exactly one input; the slots are
   painted on top of it. Per-slot inputs are what break paste, SMS autofill, IME
   composition and password managers — this component exists to avoid that, so
   wrapping it in that pattern defeats the whole point.
2. **Importing a stylesheet.** There is none to import. Everything visual is a CSS
   custom property or a `data-*` hook.
3. **Treating `onComplete` as a submit.** It fires when the code is full; it never
   calls `form.requestSubmit()` for you. Wire your verify/submit call there
   yourself. And `onChange` gives you a string — not a change event.
